title: Late-Fee Percentage Tied to the Lateness Record on Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements
content:
The late-fee percentage on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the agreement's lateness record, counted as the late fees posted on the agreement in the 12 months up to the handling date:

- **three or more** such late fees take the class's late-fee percentage plus 10 percentage points;
- **one or two** take it plus 5 points;
- **none** takes the class's late-fee percentage.

The count is read from the agreement's ledger: the late-fee entries whose posting date falls within the 12 months up to the handling date.

## Percentage by class and record

| Unit class | Class percentage | No late fee in 12 months | 1 or 2 | 3 or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 20% | 20% | 25% | 30% |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 20% | 20% | 25% | 30% |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 15% | 15% | 20% | 25% |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 15% | 15% | 20% | 25% |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 10% | 10% | 15% | 20% |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 10% | 10% | 15% | 20% |

## Boundaries

| Late fees posted in the 12 months | Points added |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 5 |
| 2 | 5 |
| 3 | 10 |
| 4 or more | 10 |

## Basis questions

- *An agreement with late fees posted 2 and 11 months before the handling date and another 14 months before?* Two fall within the 12 months, so the class percentage plus 5 points applies.
- *A Bluegate Climate Plus agreement with three late fees in the 12 months and a $200.00 rent?* 25% of $200.00 is $50.00 before rounding.
